question: Ödeme kaydı hiç olmayan siparişleri durumlarına göre say.
expected_note: orders LEFT JOIN payments, p.order_id IS NULL; pending=tam sayı, cancelled kısmi.
expected_sql: SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM read_parquet('data/processed/orders.parquet') o LEFT JOIN read_parquet('data/processed/payments.parquet') p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE p.order_id IS NULL GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY order_count DESC

question: 2024 yılında kategoriye göre net ciroyu (indirimler düşülmüş) bul, en yüksek 5 kategori.
expected_note: SUM(qty*unit_price - COALESCE(discount_amount,0)), EXTRACT(year FROM order_date)=2024
expected_sql: SELECT c.category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - COALESCE(oi.discount_amount,0)),2) AS net_ciro FROM read_parquet('data/processed/orders.parquet') o JOIN read_parquet('data/processed/order_items.parquet') oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN read_parquet('data/processed/products.parquet') p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN read_parquet('data/processed/categories.parquet') c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM o.order_date) = 2024 GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY net_ciro DESC LIMIT 5

question: Her kategoriyi üst kategorisiyle birlikte listele; kök kategoriler için '(root)' yaz.
expected_note: categories LEFT JOIN categories ON parent_category_id; category_id dahil olabilir
expected_sql: SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, COALESCE(par.category_name,'(root)') AS parent_category FROM read_parquet('data/processed/categories.parquet') c LEFT JOIN read_parquet('data/processed/categories.parquet') par ON c.parent_category_id = par.category_id ORDER BY parent_category, c.category_name

question: Ülkeye göre iade oranını yüzde olarak hesapla ve azalan sırala.
expected_note: 100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT refunds.order_id)/COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id)
expected_sql: SELECT cu.country, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id)/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2) AS refund_pct FROM read_parquet('data/processed/orders.parquet') o JOIN read_parquet('data/processed/customers.parquet') cu ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id LEFT JOIN read_parquet('data/processed/refunds.parquet') r ON o.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY cu.country ORDER BY refund_pct DESC

question: Tahsil edilen (captured) ödemelerde ödeme yöntemine göre toplam tutarı bul; tutarı NULL olanları 0 say.
expected_note: SUM(COALESCE(amount,0)) WHERE payment_status='captured'
expected_sql: SELECT payment_method, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(amount,0)),2) AS total_amount FROM read_parquet('data/processed/payments.parquet') WHERE payment_status = 'captured' GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY total_amount DESC

question: Hiç sipariş vermemiş müşteri sayısını bul.
expected_note: customers LEFT JOIN orders WHERE o.customer_id IS NULL; ~%5
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS no_order_customers FROM read_parquet('data/processed/customers.parquet') cu LEFT JOIN read_parquet('data/processed/orders.parquet') o ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.customer_id IS NULL

question: Her müşteri segmenti için ortalama sipariş değerini (AOV) ve brüt kar marjını hesapla.
expected_note: net_revenue ve SUM(qty*cost) segment bazında; delivered/shipped/paid dahil
expected_sql: SELECT cu.segment, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price - COALESCE(oi.discount_amount,0))/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2) AS aov, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price - COALESCE(oi.discount_amount,0)) - SUM(oi.quantity*p.cost),2) AS gross_margin FROM read_parquet('data/processed/orders.parquet') o JOIN read_parquet('data/processed/customers.parquet') cu ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id JOIN read_parquet('data/processed/order_items.parquet') oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN read_parquet('data/processed/products.parquet') p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY cu.segment ORDER BY aov DESC

question: Aylara göre kargolanmış ama teslim edilmemiş sipariş sayısını bul (shipped_at dolu, delivered_at boş).
expected_note: WHERE shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL
expected_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', shipped_at) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM read_parquet('data/processed/orders.parquet') WHERE shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Her kategoride net ciroya göre ilk 3 ürünü sırala (kategori içi sıralama).
expected_note: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY net_revenue DESC) <= 3; rn çıktıya dahil edilmez
expected_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT c.category_name, p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price - COALESCE(oi.discount_amount,0)),2) AS net_ciro, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price - COALESCE(oi.discount_amount,0)) DESC) AS rn FROM read_parquet('data/processed/order_items.parquet') oi JOIN read_parquet('data/processed/products.parquet') p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN read_parquet('data/processed/categories.parquet') c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name, p.product_name) SELECT category_name, product_name, net_ciro FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY category_name, net_ciro DESC

question: İade nedenlerine göre toplam iade tutarını ve adet sayısını bul.
expected_note: refunds GROUP BY reason
expected_sql: SELECT reason, COUNT(*) AS refund_count, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS total_amount FROM read_parquet('data/processed/refunds.parquet') GROUP BY reason ORDER BY total_amount DESC

question: Toplam kaç sipariş var?
expected_note: orders tablosundan basit COUNT
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM read_parquet('data/processed/orders.parquet')

question: Aktif olmayan ürün sayısı kaçtır?
expected_note: is_active=false filtresi
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS inactive_count FROM read_parquet('data/processed/products.parquet') WHERE is_active = false

question: En pahalı 5 ürünü fiyatlarıyla listele.
expected_note: price DESC LIMIT 5
expected_sql: SELECT product_name, unit_price FROM read_parquet('data/processed/products.parquet') ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 5

question: 2024 yılında aylık sipariş sayısı nasıl değişmiş?
expected_note: DATE_TRUNC month + EXTRACT year=2024
expected_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM read_parquet('data/processed/orders.parquet') WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM order_date) = 2024 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: En çok sipariş veren 10 müşteriyi bul.
expected_note: customers JOIN orders, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) DESC LIMIT 10
expected_sql: SELECT cu.full_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM read_parquet('data/processed/customers.parquet') cu JOIN read_parquet('data/processed/orders.parquet') o ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY cu.customer_id, cu.full_name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: Kategori bazında ortalama ürün fiyatı ve ürün sayısı nedir?
expected_note: products JOIN categories, AVG(price) GROUP BY category_name
expected_sql: SELECT c.category_name, ROUND(AVG(p.unit_price),2) AS avg_price, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM read_parquet('data/processed/products.parquet') p JOIN read_parquet('data/processed/categories.parquet') c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY avg_price DESC

question: Teslim edilen siparişlerde ortalama teslimat süresi kaç gündür?
expected_note: WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND status='delivered'; DATEDIFF day order_date delivered_at
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF('day', order_date, delivered_at)),1) AS avg_delivery_days FROM read_parquet('data/processed/orders.parquet') WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND status = 'delivered'

question: Ödeme yöntemine göre başarılı ödeme (captured) oranını yüzde olarak bul.
expected_note: SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status='captured') / COUNT(*) * 100
expected_sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status='captured' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS success_rate FROM read_parquet('data/processed/payments.parquet') GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY success_rate DESC

question: İptal edilen siparişlerin toplam ciro kaybı ne kadardır?
expected_note: orders WHERE status='cancelled' JOIN order_items; SUM(qty*unit_price - COALESCE(discount,0))
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price - COALESCE(oi.discount_amount,0)),2) AS lost_revenue FROM read_parquet('data/processed/orders.parquet') o JOIN read_parquet('data/processed/order_items.parquet') oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'

question: Sipariş durumuna göre iade sayısı ve toplam iade tutarını bul.
expected_note: orders JOIN refunds GROUP BY status
expected_sql: SELECT o.status, COUNT(r.refund_id) AS refund_count, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(r.amount,0)),2) AS total_refunded FROM read_parquet('data/processed/orders.parquet') o JOIN read_parquet('data/processed/refunds.parquet') r ON o.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY refund_count DESC

question: Sipariş başına ortalama kalem sayısı ve ortalama sipariş tutarı nedir?
expected_note: subquery: order_id GROUP BY → item_count + order_total; outer AVG
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(item_count),2) AS avg_items, ROUND(AVG(order_total),2) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_count, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price - COALESCE(oi.discount_amount,0)) AS order_total FROM read_parquet('data/processed/orders.parquet') o JOIN read_parquet('data/processed/order_items.parquet') oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id)

question: Aktif ürünlerde kar marjı oranı en yüksek 10 ürünü bul.
expected_note: (unit_price-cost)/unit_price fraction; same ranking as *100
expected_sql: SELECT product_name, ROUND((unit_price-cost)/unit_price,2) AS margin_ratio FROM read_parquet('data/processed/products.parquet') WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY margin_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

question: Müşteri segmentine ve yıla göre net ciro ve sipariş sayısı trendi.
expected_note: segment + EXTRACT(year) GROUP BY; no status filter (all statuses)
expected_sql: SELECT cu.segment, EXTRACT(year FROM o.order_date) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price - COALESCE(oi.discount_amount,0)),2) AS net_revenue FROM read_parquet('data/processed/orders.parquet') o JOIN read_parquet('data/processed/customers.parquet') cu ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id JOIN read_parquet('data/processed/order_items.parquet') oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY cu.segment, year ORDER BY year, net_revenue DESC

question: Aylık sipariş sayısındaki bir önceki aya göre değişimi bul (LAG).
expected_note: CTE monthly counts + LAG(order_count) OVER ORDER BY month
expected_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM read_parquet('data/processed/orders.parquet') GROUP BY month) SELECT month, order_count, LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month, order_count - LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change FROM monthly ORDER BY month

question: İptal ve iade edilmemiş siparişlerde en yüksek yaşam boyu değere (CLV) sahip 10 müşteriyi bul.
expected_note: WHERE o.status NOT IN cancelled/refunded; SUM(qty*price-COALESCE(discount,0)) GROUP BY customer
expected_sql: SELECT cu.customer_id, cu.full_name, cu.segment, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price - COALESCE(oi.discount_amount,0)),2) AS lifetime_value FROM read_parquet('data/processed/customers.parquet') cu JOIN read_parquet('data/processed/orders.parquet') o ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN read_parquet('data/processed/order_items.parquet') oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled','refunded') GROUP BY cu.customer_id, cu.full_name, cu.segment ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC LIMIT 10
